texts.orig: To identify molecular-level factors responsible for the ADT results, the two catalysts were studied by XPS, in situ XANES, and ICPMS. The Pt 4f XPS spectra of the two catalysts (Fig. 4) showed doublet peaks at 71.8 eV and 75.2 eV, which can be deconvoluted into three peaks. The deconvoluted doublet peaks at 71.5 eV and 75.0 eV, 72.8 eV and 76.3 eV, and 74 eV and 77.5 eV can be ascribed to the Pt 0 , PtO, and PtO2 phases, respectively [52].
